tool.name: ClipAllLayersToPolygon
tool.displayname: Clip All Layers to Polygon (Current Project)
tool.summary: Clip every layer of a map in the open project to a polygon layer (or its selected polygons), and save a copy of the project that uses the clipped layers.
tool.usage:
Clipped vector layers go into one file geodatabase, clipped grids are GeoTIFFs, and each layer's symbology is saved as a .lyrx file, named <layer>_clip, with a copy of the project (.aprx) beside them.

Run it from inside ArcGIS Pro with the project open. Web layers, annotation and tables are left as they are; the tool stops when you press Cancel.

param.name: in_polygon
param.dialogReference: Polygon layer to clip to (only its selected polygons if some are selected).
param.pythonReference: Polygon layer to clip to (only its selected polygons if some are selected).

param.name: out_folder
param.dialogReference: Folder for the clipped data and the project copy.
param.pythonReference: Folder for the clipped data and the project copy.

param.name: map_name
param.dialogReference: Map whose layers are clipped (blank = the active map).
param.pythonReference: Map whose layers are clipped (blank = the active map).
